title: Work Around the Shoulder Blades
summary: Gentle movements work the muscles around the shoulder blade without heavy pressure over its bony borders.
goal: Work the soft tissues around the scapular region while staying comfortable around bony landmarks.
imageAlt: Educational diagram of work around the shoulder blades without text labels.
startingPosition: The person lies face down with the arm relaxed alongside the body. Keep the shoulder blade in a natural position.
instructions: Begin with gentle strokes around the scapular area.
Use the fingers or palm to make small circles over soft tissue near the scapular borders.
Progress around the outer and lower surrounding muscle tissue.
Do not press directly on the bony edge of the shoulder blade.
direction: Follow the soft tissue around the scapular outline without pressing on the bone itself.
tips: Clearly distinguish soft tissue from the bony border.
mistakes: Heavy pressure on the scapular border or spine.
Trying to work deeply under the scapula without specific training.
warning: Do not perform this technique over acute pain, recent injury, significant inflammation, damaged skin, or when touch increases symptoms. Seek qualified professional advice when uncertain.
